facts.fact: The Office of the Accountant General's letter of 29 August 2026 refers to the existing government payroll system, to be linked to NIRA's national ID system from a pilot on 1 October 2026; the document's published date is used as no event date is given for the system itself.

The letter refers to the Somali Financial Management Information System (SFMIS) as an existing system to be integrated with NIRA's identification system; published date used as no event date is given.
